name: Video generation (Sora)
summary: POST /v1/videos with `model: sora-2` / `sora-2-pro` — async video generation from a text prompt.
description: Sora video generation exposes a top-level `model` field on `POST /v1/videos`. The endpoint runs an async job whose output is polled or delivered via webhook. This is a full first-class OpenAI surface with a `model` param, so it's a candidate for BYOM routing, but has not been validated end-to-end through a Foundry gateway connection. OpenAI has also announced Sora 2 deprecation on Sept 24 2026, so even a positive result has a limited shelf life. The follow-on endpoints `POST /v1/videos/extensions` and `POST /v1/videos/edits` inherit the model from the parent video and do not take a `model` param directly.
notes:
BYOM is expected to remain not supported because video generation is platform-native: jobs, storage, and webhooks.

Status-only card; also tracks the pending Sora 2 sunset.
